THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 11, 2016 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
COUNCIL CHAMBERS, BLOOMFIELD AVENUE AT 183RD STREET
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
FEBRUARY 11, 2016, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS, CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was given by Chaplain Norman Griffith, NASCAR motor racing.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by residents and Recreation Services Division
  volunteers Enrique, Antonio, and Ricardo Bennett.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Mark E. Pulido
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair George Ray
  Mayor/Chair Carol Chen

5.  Presentations/Appointments

  Proclamations were presented as follows:

  Cerritos high school Regiment of Gold Marching Band (Western Band Association’s 2015
  Class 2A state championships in Fresno, CA, November 22, 2015)

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Marie O’Donnell thanked the City Council for bringing back the Community
  Calendar.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 11,
  2016 (COUNCIL).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the Register
  of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 11, 2016 in the total amount of
  $6,27,970.53 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 7

7.  Consent Calendar (continued)

7B.  Adopt Ordinance No. 1002, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING
  CHAPTER 9.100 AND SECTION 22.40.300 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE
  RELATING TO THE CULTIVATION AND DELIVERY OF MARIJUANA AND MEDICAL
  MARIJUANA, HERIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE AMENDMENT 2016-1
  (COUNCIL)*.

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA review.

  *Waiver of full reading approved at introduction of ordinance on January 28, 2016.

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to adopt Ordinance
  No. 1002, AN ORDINANCE OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS AMENDING CHAPTER
  9.100 AND SECTION 22.40.300 OF THE CERRITOS MUNICIPAL CODE
  RELATING TO THE CULTIVATION AND DELIVERY OF MARIJUANA AND
  MEDICAL MARIJUANA, HERIN REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT CODE
  AMENDMENT 2016-1 (COUNCIL). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7C.  Approval of the Treasurer’s Reports for the period ending December 31, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the
  Treasurer’s Reports for  the  period  ending  December  31, 2015
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7D.  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January
  28, 2016 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Pulido, and seconded by Edwards, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 28, 2016
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY). The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 7

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 83-1 (E)(2016) AMENDMENT, A
  PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY OWNER CONANT PROPERTIES, LP (NORM REEVES
  HONDA), FOR: ADDITIONS TO THE EXISTING SHOWROOM BUILDING; AN
  EXTENSION TO THE SERVICE CANOPY; A REMODEL OF THE INTERIOR AND
  EXTERIOR OF THE EXISTING GENERAL OFFICE AND SHOWROOM BUILDING; AND
  REFURBISHMENT OF EXISTING LANDSCAPING THROUGHOUT THE PROPERTY
  LOCATED AT 18500 STUDEBAKER ROAD. THE SUBJECT PROPERTY IS ZONED
  DEVELOPMENT AREA FIVE (ADP-5) (APN 7038-013-014) (COUNCIL). *

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Robert A. Lopez, Current Planning Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  Paul Bellenbaum spoke in support of this item and made a comment about using
  solar panels.

  Lee Stacy, Vice President of Norm Reeves Honda, spoke in support of the project.

  Richard Fisler, Norm Reeves Honda, spoke in support of the project.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:
  1. Waive reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2016-02, A RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PRECISE PLAN 83-1 (E)(2016)
  AMENDMENT, A PROPOSAL BY PROPERTY OWNER CONANT
  PROPERTIES, LP (NORM REEVES HONDA), FOR: ADDITIONS TO THE
  EXISTING SHOWROOM BUILDING; AN EXTENSION TO THE SERVICE
  CANOPY; A REMODEL OF THE INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR OF THE
  EXISTING GENERAL OFFICE AND SHOWROOM BUILDING; AND
  REFURBISHMENT OF EXISTING LANDSCAPING THROUGHOUT THE
  PROPERTY LOCATED AT 18500 STUDEBAKER ROAD. THE SUBJECT
  PROPERTY IS ZONED DEVELOPMENT AREA FIVE (ADP-5) (APN 7038-
  013-014) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 4 of 7

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8B.  Review and consideration by the City Council of the City of Cerritos of the approval
  of an agreement between the City of Cerritos and the Arthur and Antonia Astor
  Family Foundation for the acceptance of a gift to the City of Cerritos from the
  collection of the Arthur and Antonio Astor Family Foundation. The gift is composed
  of various antique and Americana items, including but not limited to, vintage
  automobiles, radio broadcast equipment and televisions. Said items will be used, in
  part, for display within a new community museum to be constructed as a condition
  of the receipt of the gift.

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt a RESOLUTION OF THE
  CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PUBLIC REFERRAL PROJECT
  2016-1 (PRP 2016-1), A PROPOSAL BY THE CITY OF CERRITOS TO MAKE
  NECESSARY INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR IMPROVEMENTS TO THE EXISTING
  BUILDING LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET TO FACILITATE THE CONVERSION
  OF SAID BUILDING TO A MUSEUM USE (APN 7030-002-0902) (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Ryan Carey, Budget Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments.

  John Kitos, spoke in support of the project and complimented Heritage Park staff.

  Art Astor was recognized by the City Council and spoke about the donation.

  Bill Kelpakov, CalMet Services’, spoke in favor of the project.

  Paul Bellenbaum spoke in support of this item and commented regarding parking.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  public comments and the public hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:
  1. Authorize staff to finalize the terms and execute the museum agreement,
  substantially in the form provided as attached to the agenda report and subject to
  City Attorney approval, between the City of Cerritos, the Arthur and Antonia Astor
  Family Foundation and Astor Classics, LLC., for the development and operation of
  the proposed museum, and
  2. Waive full reading of and adopt Resolution No. 2016-03, A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS APPROVING PUBLIC
  REFERRAL PROJECT 2016-1 (PRP 2016-1), A PROPOSAL BY THE CITY OF
  CERRITOS TO MAKE NECESSARY INTERIOR AND EXTERIOR
  IMPROVEMENTS TO THE EXISTING BUILDING LOCATED AT 12616
  183RD STREET TO FACILITATE THE CONVERSION OF SAID BUILDING TO
  A MUSEUM USE (APN 7030-002-0902) (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 5 of 7

8.  Public Hearings (continued)

8C.  Review and consideration of CalMet Services’ 2016 Solid Waste Collection Program Rate
  Limits (COUNCIL).

  *Pursuant to Section 15301 of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA),
  this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  A staff report was given by Mike O’Grady, Environmental Services Manager.

  The Mayor opened the public hearing and public comments. Noting there were no
  individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed public comments and the public
  hearing.

  MOTION: It was moved by Solanki, and seconded by Edwards, to approve CalMet
  Services’ request to adjust the maximum rate schedule for solid waste services in the
  City of Cerritos by the following amounts effective January 1, 2016:

  Residential:  1.4% increase
  Commercial Bin:  0.7% increase
  Roll-Off:  1.1% increase

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of new Neighborhood Watch signs for posting on
  City streets (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Emely Merina, Community Services Supervisor.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Pulido, to approve the design of the
  new Cerritos neighborhood watch signs and direct staff to purchase the new
  Neighborhood Watch signs. The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 6 of 7

9.  New and Old Business (continued)

9B.  Review and consideration of a change order to the contract with Arcadis for
  design and construction support services for the SCADA system upgrade
  (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Kanna Vancheswaran, Director of Public Works.

  The Mayor opened public comments. Noting there were no individuals who elected to
  speak, the Mayor closed public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Ray, and seconded by Solanki, to:

  1. Authorize staff to issue and RFQ for system integrators, and
  2. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute a change order in the amount
  of $34,080 as an addition to the professional services agreement with Arcadis to
  assist the City with the RFQ process for the construction of a SCADA system update,
  and
  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any design-related change
  orders (COUNCIL).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Pulido, Solanki, Ray, Chen
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

10.  Legislative Items

10A.  Report on pending legislation

  None.

10B.  Review and consideration to support or oppose specific legislation in the State
  or Federal Legislature or in the State or Federal Executive Office for signature.

  None.

11.  City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings

  Reports were provided by Councilmembers Solanki, Pulido, and Edwards, Mayor
  Pro Tem Ray, and Mayor Chen.

12.  Closed Session

  None.
 City of Cerritos  February 11, 2016
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 7 of 7

13.  Adjournment

  The meeting was adjourned at 8:50 p.m. in memory of Bob Cameron and Maria
  Erlinda Sarno.
